name: cognisphere
description: Agent harness and per-project vault: guards, .agents scaffold, memory and rules mapping, an Agent/ workspace outside the repo.

plugins.name: cognisphere
plugins.description: Commit/secret/memory-drift guards, /cognisphere:install (= /cognisphere:harness + /cognisphere:vault), /cognisphere:update [area] and /cognisphere:read <note>, explorer/planner/implementer/test-runner/reviewer agents, and a ~/Cognisphere/Projects/<project>/ vault, with ~/Cognisphere/Shared/ readable from every project. Claude Code on Linux, macOS and Windows (Git Bash).
